'''Kok Narr''' (Kok-Nar) is an extinct [[Paman languages|Paman language]] of the [[Cape York Peninsula]], [[Queensland]], [[Australia]].

==Country==
Ancestral Koknar(Kwantari) territory is estimated to cover {{convert|2,400|mi2|km2}} and extended from [[Galbraith Station]] and the northern bank of the lower [[Staaten River]] inland to [[Old Koolatah]], north to [[Inkerman]] and the middle of the [[Nassau River]].{{sfn|Tindale|1974}}
